title: 910 Race 2026 Review: A Shoe Brand's Own Race at ICE BSD
meta_description: 910 Race 2026 review: October 11 at ICE BSD City -- Indonesian running-shoe brand 910 Nineten's own race, with distances from 5K to half marathon.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 at Indonesia Convention Exhibition, BSD City, this race is organised directly by 910 Nineten, an Indonesian running-shoe brand -- a genuinely rare case of a shoe maker running its own event rather than just sponsoring one.
verdict: The 910 Race stands out for one specific reason: it's organised directly by 910 Nineten, an Indonesian running-shoe brand, rather than a shoe company merely sponsoring someone else's event. That's a meaningfully different relationship than the branded races elsewhere in this research batch (Garmin, Pocari Sweat, Isoplus) -- 910 presumably has direct incentive to showcase its own product on a course it fully controls. Three distances (21.1K/10K/5K) at ICE BSD, a major exhibition venue in Greater Jakarta, give it solid infrastructure. Pricing (IDR 379,000-679,000) is mid-range, and registration is open.

sections.heading: A Shoe Brand Running Its Own Race
paragraphs: 910 Race is organised by 910 Nineten, an Indonesian running-shoe brand, at ICE BSD (Indonesia Convention Exhibition) in BSD City, Tangerang. [1] That's a distinctive setup: rather than sponsoring an existing race the way Garmin, Pocari Sweat or Isoplus do at events covered elsewhere in this research batch, 910 organises and presumably designs this event itself -- giving the brand direct control over the runner experience it wants to showcase.

sections.heading: Three Distances at a Major Exhibition Venue
paragraphs: The race offers 21.1K, 10K and 5K distances, with regular pricing of IDR 679,000 for the half marathon, 479,000 for the 10K, and 379,000 for the 5K. [1] ICE BSD sits within BSD City, one of Greater Jakarta's largest planned townships (roughly 6,000 hectares, home to about 500,000 people), giving the venue purpose-built infrastructure similar to how the Garmin Run Asia Series covered elsewhere in this research uses the same exhibition centre. [2]

sections.heading: What a Shoe Brand's Own Race Might Mean
paragraphs: Races organised directly by equipment brands often lean into product demos, fitting stations, and closer integration between the race-day experience and the sponsor's actual gear -- a reasonable expectation here given 910's direct organisational role, though available material doesn't detail the specific race-day activations planned.

sections.heading: Registration and Pricing
paragraphs: Registration is currently open, with pricing in a mid-range band relative to other Indonesian races in this research batch (Solo Run Fest's Rp 200,000-650,000 range, for comparison). [1] No independent participant reviews were found for this specific event, consistent with several other newer or brand-specific races in this research.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you're curious what a running-shoe brand's own race looks like when they're not just a sponsor but the actual organiser, the 910 Race on 11 October 2026 is worth trying, especially if you already run in 910's shoes. Registration is open now across all three distances.
